name: FluidVoice
title: FluidVoice: free Wispr Flow alternative
hook: Wispr Flow charges you fifteen dollars a month to type with your voice. This app does it for free.

features.intro: Press a key and just talk.
features.say: It types your words into any app, using speech models that run on your Mac.
Say a command, and it opens apps for you.
Select any text, and say how to rewrite it.

caption:
Wispr Flow charges $15/month to type with your voice. FluidVoice does it for free 🎙

✅ Types your words into any app on your Mac
✅ Speech models run on-device, no cloud needed
✅ Voice commands to open apps and run shortcuts
✅ Select text and say how to rewrite it

💻 Mac (macOS 15+, Apple Silicon; Intel via Whisper models)
ℹ️ Plain dictation works out of the box. The AI rewrite features use either the optional closed-source "Fluid Intelligence" add-on or your own AI provider key.

Comment "TYPE" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

Follow @itsongit for a new free open-source find every day

#opensource #github #macos #dictation #voicetyping #productivity #freeapps #techtips
